title: Quality is meh/lots of parts to assemble
text:
Quality is meh/lots of parts to assemble. There are a LOT of parts to this, so it took me a while just to assemble both sets. Easy to assemble wrong, so check the directions carefully. One drawer was a a bit bent from transit but it still worked so I didn't return it. The quality is so-so. I previously purchased another set of these organizers from the Container Store that cost a few dollars more, but they were much better quality. I just got impatient and didn't want to wait for shipping on those, but I wish I had.

Both of the hardware packets had one extra screw of one type, and were short one screw of another type. Not a huge deal since the missing one was the part you attach them to the cabinet, with so I could get by with 3, but still annoying.
